items.method: SEM equipped with backscatter electron (BSE) imaging
items.quote: Microstructures of the diffusion-triple and the alloy specimens are firstly examined by SEM equipped with backscatter electron (BSE) imaging.
The alloysamples are firstly melted by arc-melting in a water-cooled copper hearth under argon atmosphere, where the hearth current used is of 100-150 A.
items.synthesis: arc-melting in a water-cooled copper hearth under argon atmosphere, where the hearth current used is of 100-150 A

items.label: Zr-Y diffusion couple
items.quote: Firstly, the zirconium and yttrium bulks are diffusionally welded to make a Zr-Y diffusion couple under 20 kg pressure in argon flow at the temperature of 978 K for 15 min, then being cooled to the ambient temperature.

items.label: diffusion-triples and alloying samples
items.quote: 99.9% Zirconium, 99.97% copper and 99.5% yttrium are used as the raw materials for diffusion-triples and alloying samples.

items.label: Cu-Zr-Y diffusion-triple
items.quote: Subsequently, the Cu-Zr-Y diffusion-triple is assembled from the obtained Zr-Y couple and pure Cu bulk by diffusion welding under 15 kg pressure in argon flow at the temperature of 978 K for 15 min, again being cooled to the ambient temperature.
items.synthesis: assembled from the obtained Zr-Y couple and pure Cu bulk by diffusion welding under 15 kg pressure in argon flow at the temperature of 978 K for 15 min

items.applies_to: Zr-Y couple and pure Cu bulk
items.purpose: assembled from the obtained Zr-Y couple and pure Cu bulk by diffusion welding
items.quote: Subsequently, the Cu-Zr-Y diffusion-triple is assembled from the obtained Zr-Y couple and pure Cu bulk by diffusion welding under 15 kg pressure in argon flow at the temperature of 978 K for 15 min, again being cooled to the ambient temperature.

items.atmosphere_or_container: evacuated quartz tube backfilled with pure argon
items.purpose: To ensure homogeneity, the alloying samples are encapsulated in evacuated quartz tube backfilled with pure argon and annealed
items.quote: To ensure homogeneity, the alloying samples are encapsulated in evacuated quartz tube backfilled with pure argon and annealed at the temperature of 978 K controlled to within ±2 K. After being annealed for 1460 h, the alloying samples are taken out from the furnace and quenched to the ambient temperature.

items.purpose: diffusionally welded to make a Zr-Y diffusion couple
items.quote: Firstly, the zirconium and yttrium bulks are diffusionally welded to make a Zr-Y diffusion couple under 20 kg pressure in argon flow at the temperature of 978 K for 15 min, then being cooled to the ambient temperature.

items.atmosphere_or_container: evacuated quartz tube backfilled with pure argon
items.cooling: cooled quickly to the ambient temperature
items.quote: Finally, the diffusion-triple is encapsulated in evacuated quartz tube backfilled with pure argon and annealed at the temperature of 978 K controlled to within ±2 K. After being annealed for 2469 h, the diffusion-triple is taken out from the furnace and cooled quickly to the ambient temperature.
